description.fallback: Jotaro awakens to see the barber attacking Polnareff with a sword. Polnareff explains to Jotaro that the sword is a Stand, and that it is possessing the barber. Polnareff uses Silver Chariot to attack with all his might, but Anubis knows all about Silver Chariot's abilities and limitations.

intro.fallback: Jotaro awakens to see the barber attacking Polnareff with a sword.
Polnareff explains to Jotaro that the sword is a Stand, and that it is possessing the barber.
Polnareff uses Silver Chariot to attack with all his might, but Anubis knows all about Silver Chariot's abilities and limitations.

outro.fallback: However, a policeman spots Polnareff and grabs the sword from him, thinking he is partaking in illegal activities.
The two tug at the sword until Polnareff accidentally unsheathes it.
